== Source, printing and text-state verification (Story 386) ==
The [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-world-championship-top-8-dennis-reinhardt-ls-skywalker-saga-luke/ published Players Committee decklist] was compared with the [[Media:26Worlds T8 Reinhardt LS Luke Saga.txt|wiki-hosted XML download]] and the card articles linked in the table. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114025203/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2026-world-championship-top-8-dennis-reinhardt-ls-skywalker-saga-luke.html Players Committee decklist]. The download's File page attributes the XML to the forum distribution; the original forum ZIP has not been independently byte-verified.
The download contains 60 constructed-card entries. Its SHA-256 is <code>97182ee9d67d8051f7e278325ff81e18f505b2b1b86d8e1a89cf9f9e03586646</code>; the download bytes were retained. The article lists 60 constructed cards and 29 outside-deck cards. Each outside-deck XML identity is counted separately; a card outside the deck is placed in its own card-type group when it is not a Defensive Shield.

=== Printing choices ===
* 1x [[Padmé Naberrie (V) (ALT) (Errata)]]: XML <nowiki>203_36</nowiki>. The published list says <nowiki>1x Padme Naberrie (AI) (V)</nowiki>. The linked AI/ALT belongs to the same card family and its engine gameplay record matches the ordinary image after excluding image-identity fields.
